title: Music City Getaway, Large Nashville home
description:
Bring the whole family to this great place with lots of room for fun. Stylish and comfortable, you will make memories here. Open kitchen, dining and family room with a large outdoor deck for grilling and relaxing alfresco dining at our large table. Pool table and sitting area upstairs for some friendly competition. Enjoy Music City and then come home to this comfortable space. This family home is ready for your group. Laundry room if needed. TV with streaming in LR/ and 2 bedrooms.

The space
Hi Future Guests!

My wife and I have loved this place since we bought it in 2009. It's a big house in a beautiful, hilly, safe, and family-oriented neighborhood that is less than 10 minutes from downtown Nashville and 15 from the airport.

It's got 3 bedrooms, one of which is very large, a big, bright living room with high ceilings, a beautiful pool table, a large back porch surrounded by woods, and a kitchen with concrete countertops that I poured myself (with the help of some session musicians you have definitely heard on the radio).

During the years that we were touring musicians, we rented the house out short-term while we were away and managed it ourselves. At some point we had a plumbing problem and it was very stressful trying to deal with it from far away, so we hired our friend Angie who works with an amazing local management company to look after the guests for us while we're out of town.

There are a few things to know about this place:
1. It is very well loved, large, and very clean, but it is not one of the new construction tall-and-skinnies you see on AirBnB. Much of the kitchen, the drywall, and the floors are new, but we're currently saving up to do the bathrooms and there's some 80s panelling we are itching to get rid of. If you want something large, personal, clean, and cheap then this place is for you. If you're looking for fancy then you probably want to spend a few extra dollars. Almost all of our guests have felt like they got more than their money's worth.

2. Occasionally we get a last-minute session we have to fly in for, and when that happens we'll grab our car out of the garage and stay with friends. The garage is in the unfinished basement and not connected to the rented living area -- so most people never notice, but it's possible you'll hear the garage open and close once during your stay.

3. It is a reasonably quiet neighborhood and if there's a loud party our neighbors will be giving us a call. That's only happened twice in 15 years -- they don't mind normal noise! So just use common sense -- hanging out in the front yard is fine, but blasting music late at night outside is something they will definitely call us about.

4. We love to hear ideas from guests about improving the place, so don't hold back! (That's how we got the pool table).

Please reach out to Angie if you have any issues during your stay (since she's near and we're far), and we hope you love Nashville!

Oh yeah -- some stuff we love in the city:
1. The Pharmacy Burger -- the best burgers in town and a big outside patio.
2. Centennial Park -- There's a life-size replica of the Parthenon and a great mile-long track if you like to run.
3. Burger Up -- It's a great, reasonably priced date-night.
4. Five Points Pizza -- the best NY style pizza
5. 3rd & Lindsley -- our favorite place to see touring and local music. There's always something good there. Especially the Time Jumpers.

Thanks and hope you enjoy your stay!
-Brian and Rachel

Guest access
We have a smart lock for easy access.

Other things to note
Please ask any questions about our property. We want you to have complete peace of mind booking your stay. Our home is a great get away for you and your family and friends.
